name: Plugin Dashboard
author: martythedev-tech
description: Lists every third-party and custom Omarchy plugin -- including itself -- plus the apps you track (installed packages or source repos you build), with enable/disable, diff preview, update-all, a Discover tab for the official plugin catalog, and a real update check against each one's actual upstream (git, package repos, AUR).

barWidget.description: Badge shows how many of your plugins/apps have an update available. Click to open, enable/disable, and update.
